steps.name: Sora
steps.text: You don't know the kind of person he is, but I understand him.

spans.text: You don't know the kind of person he is, but

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Don't you think we place too much faith in our ability to 'understand' someone? Don't you think we're all too easily blinded by the illusions born of emotion and impulse?

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Salvadore... He deserves to step out of Columbia's dark alleyways.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: My sister, he is a Siracusan, and you know nothing about how he operates. You really think he could help us get rich?

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: All he's gonna do is get himself burnt - and we're gonna get caught in the middle.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: He uses his fists to protect himself, and then law and order to shackle his fists. Is that not enough for you?

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Get your head out of the clouds already.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: No, brother. Other Siracusans wear their scars and bloodstains like badges of honor.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Only he knows that blood is nothing more than blood.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: So, Sora, how's my acting?

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Want me to give it to you straight?

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: You bet I do.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Absolutely terrible! Exusiai, you've got, like, zero talent for this!

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Ehh? I feel like I'm pretty emotionally invested though.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Just being emotionally invested doesn't make you a good actor.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: But... as far as the script is concerned, you're on the right track! At least you aren't flubbing any of your lines.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: How low were your expectations?!

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: What do you think, Croissant?

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Pretty darn good, if ya ask me!

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Only thing is, when yer expressin' yer dissatisfaction with the brother, think ya could dial the emotions back a notch?

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Hmm, so try to get the point across some other way? I... can give that a try in a moment.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Woah, Croissant, since when were you an expert?

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Hey, don't go underestimatin' a gal who sits in on Sora's classes every week. Not like a certain two someones who come and go without a word.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Hey, I'd never leave without saying anything.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Not what I meant...

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: But at least this proves we'll be able to find her for sure, right?

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Damn straight we will.
Quite the unique performance.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Ehh?

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Excuse me, but are you...
My name is Benthonexigios.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Oh, hello, Bensomething-or-other...

steps.name: Ben
steps.text: Feel free call me Ben.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Sure thing, Ben!

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Um, excuse me, Mr. Ben, if there's nothing you need from us, I'm afraid I'll have to ask you to leave. We're still in the middle of rehearsal.

steps.name: Ben
steps.text: Of course there is. I'm currently watching the performance, am I not?

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: I don't think someone who's walking around eating pizza counts as watching anything.

steps.name: Ben
steps.text: Am I not allowed to watch the performance while enjoying pizza?

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Well, don't theaters usually have rules against that?

steps.name: Ben
steps.text: That's a rule imposed on people by the theater, not by the play itself.

steps.name: Ben
steps.text: Norms have a way of making people superficially conflate these things, and hold them with the same degree of reverence, even erecting false pedestals upon which to elevate them. True reverence, however, is much harder to find.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Ben
steps.text: Would you like a bite, young lady?

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: You betcha!

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Bleh, the texture's awful!

steps.name: Ben
steps.text: It's the cheapest street pizza you can find, after all. That said, their sauce is actually quite respectable.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Um... so if you were watching our performance just now, what'd you think of it?

steps.name: Ben
steps.text: The key takeaway is that there are some differences between the methods of capturing and expressing emotions that you seem to be adept at, versus the demands of opera.

steps.name: Ben
steps.text: You are clearly used to standing in front of an audience. Or should I say, you're so used to it that it makes it hard for you to stand on stage as an actor.

steps.name: Ben
steps.text: That is not an indictment of your abilities, but is nevertheless a trial you must overcome.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Woah, I didn't expect you to be a total pro at this.

steps.name: Ben
steps.text: Think about it. You are the daughter of a wealthy Columbian magnate. He, Salvadore, is a vagrant from Siracusa.

steps.name: Ben
steps.text: He's different from all the other men you've ever met. He does not care about your status, but values you for who you are.

steps.name: Ben
steps.text: He is more indolent than anyone else, yet also cleverer.

steps.name: Ben
steps.text: He seems destined to become don of a famiglia, setting off on a perilous road from which there is no turning back.

steps.name: Ben
steps.text: Tell me, young lady, is this someone you could love?

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Someone... I could love...

steps.name: Ben
steps.text: No, you are terrified! The more you love him, the more he terrifies you!

steps.name: Ben
steps.text: You have no chance of keeping him.

steps.name: Ben
steps.text: Your intuition tells you that you should escape. That he never belonged to you.

steps.name: Ben
steps.text: You've told yourself countless times that he is just another passerby on the road of life. That even if he slips away, you can find innumerable others who are better.

steps.name: Ben
steps.text: You know that if you chase after him, your life will become as a landship in an endless desert, unable to see your course.

steps.name: Ben
steps.text: You don't even know if the decision you made is right or wrong.

steps.name: Ben
steps.text: But despite all that, you still turn to your relatives and yell—

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: 'Only he knows that blood is nothing more than blood!'

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Wooooah.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Oooooh!

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: So that's the feeling I've been missing this whole time...

steps.name: Ben
steps.text: Yet you already seem to understand it well, young lady.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Let's give it another run-through, Exusiai!

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Lemme get a sip of water first—

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Haha, ya ain't gettin' away that easy when Sora's in the zone.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: I'll go fetch some drinks for y'all. And some grub while I'm at it.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Mr. Ben, anything ya'd—

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Huh? Where'd he go?

steps.name: Witness
steps.text: Ah, the police are finally here! Over here, ma'am!

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: I'm not the police. I am Lavinia, a municipal judge for Volsinii.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: Siracusa has no police, Signor.

steps.name: Witness
steps.text: What? No police?

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: Are you a foreigner? In this country, 'they' are the ones responsible for maintaining law and order on the streets.

steps.name: Witness
steps.text: Who are 'they'? I'm just visiting for some business discussions, so I don't quite understand.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: Hmph. I'm talking about the mafiosi. You'd best steer clear of them.

steps.name: Witness
steps.text: I... I know that much.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: Where's the scene of the crime?

steps.name: Witness
steps.text: T-Take a look for yourself... Right there, behind the dumpster.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: Five people. They couldn't have died more than a day ago. From their outfits, they seem to be from the same famiglia.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: Hold on...

steps.name: Witness
steps.text: What's wrong, ma'am?

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: I saw them... just this morning.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: They attacked a public official earlier. I confronted them about it, but let them go.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: But why here of all places... and their leader isn't with them either.

steps.name: Witness
steps.text: I... I've always heard that Siracusa is a dangerous place.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: No, if this was a conflict between famiglie, they would've made sure to clean up the scene.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: This doesn't make any sense.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: For your own safety, act as if you never saw anything.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: I'll handle the rest here.

steps.name: Witness
steps.text: Y-Yes, ma'am!

steps.name: Witness
steps.text: Damn it, I need to get out of this godforsaken place this instant...
Signorina Lavinia, I didn't expect you to ever call me first.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: Demetri, noticed any flamboyant hitmen around town recently?

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: Hmm? Huh... You'd have to either be incredibly brave or incredibly stupid to stick your neck out these days.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: ...Do you need me to throw last month's crime reports in your face?

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: I think there's been a little misunderstanding here.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: Just now, five bodies were found in a back alley on Viale Orvieto. The scene wasn't cleaned up, which suggests it wasn't the work of one of the famiglie.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: And just this morning, I saw these same folks attacking a public official.

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: Huh, now that's new and exciting.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: I don't care about the little power struggle between you people, but don't forget that our ironclad rule still stands.

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: Setting aside recent developments, even in ordinary times the fact still stands that Volsinii is run by Famiglia Bellone, and has a judge as principled as you.

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: Pulling a stunt like this is tantamount to spitting in our faces, and nobody would dare do something like that.

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: Unless...

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: Unless they're Columbian. Is that what you wanted to say?

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: It could be anyone who doesn't give two shits about the rules we've set.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: Just keep me posted if you learn anything.

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: I don't recall having to answer to you, Your Honor.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: Is this not also 'tantamount to spitting in the face of Famiglia Bellone'?

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: Fine then, I'll tell Leon. Maybe he has enough spare time on his hands.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: First, attacks on government officials. Now, hitmen out of nowhere.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: Is there really a connection between these?
The humid air creeps inside.
Lavinia's mind races with the details of the latest case as she makes her way back to the courthouse.
She knows full well what looms overhead, but everyone here, including herself, takes it for granted.
At the entrance to the courthouse, Lavinia looks over at her car, and cannot help but let out a sigh.
It has been splashed with paint, and now stands out conspicuously among its neighbors.
A simple gesture of malice.
These acts used to make her feel at a loss for words, but now they trouble her no more than the continuous drizzle.
Of course, there is still the cost of getting the car cleaned.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: Sorry.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Be careful out there, signorina.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: The rain doesn't seem like it'll let up anytime soon. You might slip if you don't watch your step.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: Thanks for the reminder. But you don't seem to have an umbrella either.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: I'm not a fan. I rather enjoy the feeling of raindrops on my skin.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: Then I hope you also watch your step.

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: Why are you trying to provoke her?

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: And what makes you think that's what I'm doing? Ohh, you think you've got me all figured out now, huh?

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: Forget I said anything.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: I was trying to provoke her, though.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: She had a familiar scent on her. One I hate.

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: Suit yourself. But you're the one who wanted us to break into Famiglia Bellone. And I think this is just making us more suspicious.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: I need to know exactly what is happening in this city, and why they wanted to bring Texas back.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: So what do you reckon we do? Work our way up from hired guns? Rise through the ranks until we become the Bellones' top hitmen?

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: Well, Gambino'd probably like the sound of that, at least.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: That's way too inefficient.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: You guys need some bargaining chips, isn't that right?

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: So where is Gambino?

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: Already on his way to the middleman, to cash in the bounty.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Hah, look at that. Here in Siracusa, he's a lot better than you at climbing the ranks.

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: I don't deny that.

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: After spending so much time in Lungmen, I'm more shocked at how this place hasn't changed a bit. Not used to it at all anymore.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Trust me, you'll get used to it again soon enough. Just like Gambino.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: After all, you're a Siracusan.

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: You really gonna let him plant his roots down here again?

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Why not? There's nothing stopping you either. Be loud and proud about it. I certainly wouldn't get in your way.

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: The more I think about it, the less I understand. What exactly are you trying to accomplish?

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: I'm just enjoying the rainy season. What, do you not like the rain?

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: All I know is, Gambino hates the rain.

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: So, what news did you get your hands on?

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Wanna find out?

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: Sure, say I do. What would you have me do?

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: You're in luck. I just happen to be in need of a driver.

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: ...*sigh*.

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: Come on in, signor istigatore.

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: I came back alive, bartender.

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: Your skills aren't half bad. But neither you, Gambino, nor that friend of yours who left for Lungmen eight years ago, Capone, are good enough.

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: Don't start talking like you're some hot shit, cub!

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: You're just like the rumors said. Completely clueless as to when you should and shouldn't press your luck.

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: Is that not how the last Sicilians lost the favor of Signora Sicilia?

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: Look at the ones today. What can they do now, except cling to their last pathetic scrap of glory?

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: Listen up, Gambino. I don't give a shit what you and Capone came back to Siracusa to do, nor do I care who's backing you behind the scenes.

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: All I care about is your ability, and the kind of work you can do.

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: So, what do you think of our work then?

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: You're not one of us, and you've got guts. Both are good.

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: So you keep doing good work for me, and I pay you. The better you do, the more you get paid. Simple as that.

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: You want to see Bellone. Once you've satisfied me, I'll arrange a meeting.

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: I'm going to do such a good job that you'll regret it.

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: You know, I don't hate the fact that you Sicilians ooze ruthlessness from your bones.

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: That's something Siracusans could use more of these days.

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: So, let's see you try.

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: When the time comes, you'll realize that I never regret a thing.
The banquet is about to begin, and people have been lining up early to wait outside the door.
Welcome, Mr. Beato.

steps.name: Haughty Official
steps.text: And you are?
Rubio. We met at the banquet last week.

steps.name: Haughty Official
steps.text: Ah, I remember now, il Segretario di Sicurezza Alimentare. Rubio. I do apologize for this porous mind of mine.

steps.name: Haughty Official
steps.text: Seeing as you're here, I'm sure tonight's meal is not to be missed.

steps.name: Rubio
steps.text: Hardly, good sir. But as we are expecting some rather esteemed guests tonight, I did put in a little extra effort.

steps.name: Haughty Official
steps.text: I see, I see.

steps.name: Snobby Official
steps.text: Over here, Beato.

steps.name: Haughty Official
steps.text: I'll be right there. Now, if you'll excuse me.

steps.name: Snobby Official
steps.text: Who was that?

steps.name: Haughty Official
steps.text: Rubio, Segretario di Sicurezza Alimentare.

steps.name: Snobby Official
steps.text: What? He's actually a government official, looking like that? I ignored him when I first came in because I thought he was just a doorman.

steps.name: Haughty Official
steps.text: Not that you're missing out on much. He might as well be a clown.

steps.name: Snobby Official
steps.text: Why do you say that?

steps.name: Haughty Official
steps.text: He's not from one of the famiglie, and after a lifetime of struggling, the best position he could claw himself into was the director of that no-name dipartimento.

steps.name: Haughty Official
steps.text: And after he landed the position, he went around kissing the asses of various famiglie until he somehow managed to bumble his way into some renown.

steps.name: Haughty Official
steps.text: Nowadays, his dipartimento pretty much caters all events in Volsinii, large and small.

steps.name: Haughty Official
steps.text: He doesn't care about his image at all, standing in front of the door to greet the guests like that. I mean, you saw him.

steps.name: Snobby Official
steps.text: I see. That said though, there is a thing or two we could learn from his sorry mug.
I must congratulate you, Rubio.

steps.name: Rubio
steps.text: Oh my... What might the occasion be?
Word on the street is that young master Leontuzzo will be attending the banquet tonight.
The heir to Famiglia Bellone, the great celebrity by Carracci's side, has never attended a banquet like this before.
This is your big break, isn't it?

steps.name: Rubio
steps.text: Haha... Signor Wallach, you must have been quite pleased with the batch of steaks I sent you the other day.

steps.name: Rubio
steps.text: Otherwise, I'm sure you wouldn't be calling me just to joke around in such a manner.

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: Hahaha.

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: Things have changed, Rubio. I may be the boss of Famiglia Rossati in this city and made a bit of a name for myself, but there are still plenty of rules I must abide by.

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: For example, I have to break the bread of fellowship with a guy like you.

steps.name: Rubio
steps.text: Your support is always appreciated.

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: It's good that we all treat each other like family. You scratch my back, I scratch yours. If we have any issues, we settle them on the table.

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: None of us enjoy spending all day fighting and killing each other. It's just, a necessity born of circumstance. Isn't that right?

steps.name: Rubio
steps.text: Indeed. You work too hard these days, Signor Wallach.

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: Il Ministero dei Trasporti is headed by a Bellone, and he normally keeps his distance from me. Tch, not much I can do to him.

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: But il Ministro al Commercio is a smart man, a good friend of mine. Naturally, he enjoys the Rossatis' full support.

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: The host of tonight's banquet, Carracci, Ministro dei Lavori Pubblici, is an unpredictable man, though. Even though he's got Bellone's little pup following him around, he manages to stay on decent terms with everyone.

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: Rubio, food safety is very important, is it not? I do hope you are also a smart man.

steps.name: Rubio
steps.text: Of course, of course.

steps.name: Rubio
steps.text: The VIP arrived just now. Excuse me, I must be off.

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: See you.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: I know how strong you are, Signorina Texas. Unfortunately, I am not a man who enjoys resorting to violence.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: Using force is the least efficient method.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: So if you were expecting to leave Siracusa after making a few heads roll on my behalf, I'm afraid you'll be quite disappointed.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Just... tell me what I need to do.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: Carracci, Volsinii's Ministro dei Lavori Pubblici.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: He is responsible for the construction of the new nomadic city plate. He's also one of our men, and I need you to protect him.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: A government official?

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: I know what you're going to say.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: 'The government is just the cloth draped over Grey Hall's round table.'

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: Every associate of every famiglia remembers Signora Sicilia's lament.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: There was once a time when we never took stock of the vases and cutlery sitting on our tablecloth.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: But right now, it's something we must pay close attention to.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: When the Columbians brought new things back with them, what disturbed me most was not their technology, but rather...

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: How they do things nothing like we do in Siracusa.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: They knew that Siracusa's officials were never going to turn their backs on the old guard of the famiglie, so they never required those officials to defer to them in public.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: All they needed was for them to turn a blind eye at just the right moment, or whenever it was convenient for them.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: And what can we do? Getting rid of those officials won't solve anything.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: Try to settle things with them directly? They're not stupid enough to give the game away.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: Despite the not-insignificant amount of power and influence we have here, there is nothing we can do about them.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: I believe that you, having spent a number of years living in Lungmen, should be more familiar with their way of doing things.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: ...To the point I almost thought I was back in Lungmen.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: Hah. But here in Siracusa, few people even realize how big the shockwaves from the Columbian approach might end up being.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: You know, Signorina Texas, when I really dove into the nitty-gritty of this approach, to better understand it, the only thing I felt was...

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: Admiration.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: The weapons they deploy are profits and negotiations, not violence and bloodshed.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: So you also studied their methods.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: Studied? No... I'll do it better than them.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: And Carracci is my trump card.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: Recently, there's been a sudden outbreak of assassinations on government officials around the city. Though I haven't confirmed who's behind the attacks yet, I must ensure the safety of Ministro Carracci.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: He's an interesting man, and prefers to walk over taking the car. Even though I have people protecting him in secret, I do not feel at ease.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: Now, I've already given them a heads up. Go bring him over to the banquet venue.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: (The target is crossing the street right ahead. There should be at least seven mafiosi covering him from the shadows.)

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: (Seems like there won't be any major issues...)

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Would you look at that. Didn't I just say something good was about to happen?

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Texas, care for some mille-feuille?
